misprints.note: ουσα is printed with no breathing or accent. The same thing happens twice in 0495_03, after διαφέρων and after ὑπερβάλλων.
The first sense is numbered a) and the second 2).

uncertain.note: The print shows '(ἀπο' followed by a small dot and then 'κάμνειν', with no clear closing parenthesis. I read the dot as a broken ')'.
The punctuation at the right margin after ἀκριβοῦν is cut off at the edge of the scan. Read as a full stop.
The breathings on αὑτοῦ are small and hard to make out. Read as rough.
